chapters: Maya wows investors with a Sprintboard “Smart Minutes” demo secretly juiced by a shadow calendar scrape.
Aaron embeds and flags stale DPAs, missing DPIA, redacted Okta logs, and Rishi’s blocked access to product logs.
Maya and Aaron co-write consent copy in a late-night standup, trading dry jokes while tightening Jira scopes.
Tom Reyes reports PHI-like phrases in Looker, and Aaron traces token scope creep and an exposed S3 audio-hash index.
Maya books a DPIA workshop with Ava and locks a short-term consent patch while syncing remediation tasks in Jira with Aaron.

Jonah circulates a Looker join re-identifying “anonymous” attendees, Aaron gets only a PDF instead of Okta export, badge logs pin a 2 a.m. data-center visit to Maya’s card, Sloane calls, and the demo pipeline dies.
act_scenes:
Chapter 1:
Scene 1:
- Characters: Maya, QA lead (Priya), Data eng (Leo)
- Place: Sprintboard demo lab
- Time: Morning, Demo Day -3 hours
- Event: Maya rehearses “Smart Minutes”; shadow calendar scrape powers slick summaries.
- Conflict: Priya flags unscoped calendar fields appearing in the demo data.
- Story value: Integrity vs. expediency
- Story value charge: Negative
- Mood: Tense, focused
- Outcome: Maya silences the flag, proceeds with the juice.

Scene 2:
- Characters: Maya, Investors (2 partners), BD lead (Kara)
- Place: Investor conference room
- Time: Late morning, same day
- Event: Live demo wows investors; questions about data provenance surface.
- Conflict: Investor presses on consent lineage; Maya dodges with “aggregated/ephemeral.”
- Story value: Credibility
- Story value charge: Positive
- Mood: Electric, brittle underneath
- Outcome: Investors impressed; follow-up diligence requested.

Chapter 2:
Scene 1:
- Characters: Aaron, Procurement manager (Nikhil)
- Place: Compliance bullpen
- Time: Next day, afternoon
- Event: Aaron audits vendor files; finds stale DPAs, missing DPIA.
- Conflict: Nikhil insists renewals “in flight”; no dates.
- Story value: Compliance posture
- Story value charge: Negative
- Mood: Methodical, frustrated
- Outcome: Aaron files blockers, opens Jira tickets.

Scene 2:
- Characters: Aaron, Rishi, IT security (Marta)
- Place: IT/security war room
- Time: Evening, same day
- Event: Aaron requests Okta logs, product logs; gets redacted Okta output; Rishi’s access remains blocked.
- Conflict: Marta cites “least privilege”; Aaron cites audit scope.
- Story value: Transparency
- Story value charge: Negative
- Mood: Defensive
- Outcome: Partial access only; redaction policy stands.

Chapter 3:
Scene 1:
- Characters: Maya, Aaron
- Place: Standup corner, open office
- Time: Late night, mid-week
- Event: They co-write consent copy, align copy with product surfaces.
- Conflict: Tone vs. conversion—plain language vs. growth targets.
- Story value: Team cohesion
- Story value charge: Positive
- Mood: Dry humor, tired
- Outcome: Draft consent text finalized; acceptance criteria sketched.

Scene 2:
- Characters: Maya, Aaron, PM (Dee)
- Place: Jira board
- Time: Same night, later
- Event: Tighten scopes; descopes low-value stories to hit Friday build.
- Conflict: Dee resists moving backlog items; launch risk vs. scope creep.
- Story value: Focus
- Story value charge: Positive
- Mood: Surgical
- Outcome: Lean consent MVP locked; non-essentials punted.

Chapter 4:
Scene 1:
- Characters: Tom Reyes, Aaron
- Place: Looker floor, analytics area
- Time: Next morning
- Event: Tom shows PHI-like phrases in Looker searches and tiles.
- Conflict: Is it true PHI or model artifact? Tom wants it pulled; Aaron needs proof.
- Story value: Risk exposure
- Story value charge: Negative
- Mood: Alarming, contained
- Outcome: Query IDs captured; data lineage trace opened.

Scene 2:
- Characters: Aaron, DevOps lead (Irene)
- Place: DevOps Slack + AWS console
- Time: Early afternoon, same day
- Event: Aaron traces token scope creep; finds exposed S3 audio-hash index.
- Conflict: Irene argues bucket is “hashes only”; Aaron shows joinability risk.
- Story value: Data safety
- Story value charge: Negative
- Mood: Adversarial
- Outcome: Temporary bucket policy tightened; full fix scheduled.

Chapter 5:
Scene 1:
- Characters: Maya, Ava (privacy counsel)
- Place: Zoom
- Time: Next morning
- Event: Maya books DPIA workshop; aligns on lawful basis and risk register.
- Conflict: Ava pushes for DPIA pre-release; Maya needs post-release runway.
- Story value: Governance
- Story value charge: Positive
- Mood: Professional, brisk
- Outcome: Workshop set for Monday; interim mitigations agreed.

Scene 2:
- Characters: Maya, Aaron
- Place: Huddle room + Jira
- Time: Afternoon, same day
- Event: Lock short-term consent patch; sync remediation tasks.
- Conflict: Timeline pressure vs. test coverage; Aaron pushes for log reviews.
- Story value: Accountability
- Story value charge: Positive
- Mood: Pragmatic
- Outcome: Patch slated for Friday deploy; audit tasks linked to release.

Chapter 6:
Scene 1:
- Characters: Jonah, Aaron, IT (Marta), Facilities (Gus)
- Place: Company email + security desk
- Time: Friday morning
- Event: Jonah circulates Looker join re-identifying “anonymous” attendees; Aaron requests Okta export, receives only a PDF; badge logs show 2 a.m. data-center entry on Maya’s card.
- Conflict: Evidence vs. access—Aaron can’t validate without raw logs; card use disputed.
- Story value: Liability
- Story value charge: Negative
- Mood: Alarming, brittle
- Outcome: Incident channel opened; Maya pinged for explanation.

Scene 2:
- Characters: Maya, Sloane (CEO), Aaron, DevOps (Irene)
- Place: Exec conference bridge
- Time: Late morning, same day
- Event: Sloane calls; demo pipeline dies mid-triage.
- Conflict: Blame and prioritization—contain incident vs. revive demo.
- Story value: Survival
- Story value charge: Negative
- Mood: Crisis
- Outcome: Launch blocked; war room declared; Maya put on point under scrutiny.

Tom Reyes flags a Sprintboard task echoing Priya’s trauma case and threatens license pulls over missing BAAs after Maya confirms healthcare tenants slipped in. (-)

Jonah publishes Looker tiles tying conversion jumps to the shadow feed for board review as Leila orders “Zero Click” to ship and Aaron confronts Maya over a midnight Okta edit from her admin token. (-)
Aaron proves visitor temp badges can clone IDs with a script and drafts a token‑rotation and log‑restoration plan with Rishi. (+)

act_scenes:
Chapter 7:
Scene 1:
Characters: Aaron, Maya
Place: Long Island City coworking lab
Time: Morning, Day 1 of Act II
Event: They diff Snowflake grants across schemas and spot a hidden role path feeding “anonymous” text enrichment.
Conflict: Aaron wants to escalate immediately; Maya wants proof airtight before alerting security.
Story value: Integrity vs velocity
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Tense, forensic
Outcome: They isolate ClearLambda as the enrichment stage but lack a smoking gun.

Scene 2:
Characters: Aaron, Maya, ClearLambda SRE (off-call), Data Eng on-call
Place: Same lab, then Slack/Zoom war-room
Time: Late afternoon, Day 1
Event: They stage a freeze on the ClearLambda join by crafting a canary pipeline and a reversible role deny on the service account.
Conflict: Eng pushes back on impact to demos; Maya leverages audit risk to win a limited freeze.
Story value: Control over exposure
Story value charge: Positive
Mood: Surgical, cautious
Outcome: Narrow freeze approved; logs bookmarked for deeper trace.

Chapter 8:
Scene 1:
Characters: Ava, Aaron, Maya, Felix, DPIA group
Place: Conference room, DPIA workshop
Time: Morning, Day 2
Event: Ava scores the feature high-risk under DPIA, citing identifiability through directory joins.
Conflict: Felix frames risk as “mitigated” and pressures to re-score.
Story value: Compliance vs revenue pressure
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Combative, political
Outcome: High-risk noted but flagged “pending mitigation,” creating ambiguity.

Scene 2:
Characters: Aaron, Maya, Victor
Place: Hallway then Zoom 1:1
Time: Early evening, Day 2
Event: Felix orders Aaron to bless by EOD; Victor dangles VP title for Maya tied to closing the term sheet if demos stay green.
Conflict: Career incentive vs ethical line; Aaron resists deadline, Maya stays noncommittal.
Story value: Loyalty vs ambition
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Cornered, transactional
Outcome: EOD pressure stands; Maya leaves with leverage but unease.

Chapter 9:
Scene 1:
Characters: Rishi, Aaron
Place: Security pit, Okta admin console
Time: Morning, Day 3
Event: Rishi traces elevated access to a mis-tagged SCIM sync assigning a privileged group to the service account.
Conflict: Limited log retention threatens chain-of-custody; Aaron argues for emergency exports.
Story value: Evidence preservation
Story value charge: Positive
Mood: Methodical, time-pressed
Outcome: Start pulling Okta API events before rotation scrubs them.

Scene 2:
Characters: Rishi, Aaron, Maya
Place: Whiteboard room
Time: Afternoon, Day 3
Event: They reconstruct timing of bad group inheritance from API rows, aligning spikes with the shadow feed.
Conflict: Maya questions causality vs correlation; Rishi defends timestamp integrity.
Story value: Clarity of cause
Story value charge: Positive
Mood: Analytical, skeptical
Outcome: Credible timeline established; need corroboration from Snowflake access logs.

Chapter 10:
Scene 1:
Characters: Tom Reyes (counsel), Maya, Aaron, Ops PM
Place: Compliance review call
Time: Late morning, Day 4
Event: Tom flags a Sprintboard task mirroring Priya’s trauma case and asks about BAAs for healthcare tenants.
Conflict: Ops claims “pilot exception”; Tom rejects and cites regulatory exposure.
Story value: Liability
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Alarming, procedural
Outcome: Missing BAAs confirmed; risk escalated.

Scene 2:
Characters: Maya, Aaron, Tom
Place: Maya’s glass office
Time: Late afternoon, Day 4
Event: Maya confirms healthcare tenants slipped into demos; Tom threatens license pulls if BAAs not executed.
Conflict: Maya wants 2 weeks; Tom sets 48-hour deadline.
Story value: Urgency vs feasibility
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Stark, deadline-driven
Outcome: 48-hour ultimatum logged; customer list requested.

Chapter 11:
Scene 1:
Characters: Maya, Aaron
Place: DUMBO bar back table
Time: Night, Day 4
Event: They run a war-room: task list to remove shadow feed from demo pipelines, owners and rollback plan.
Conflict: Maya pushes cut now; Aaron wants staged removal to preserve evidence.
Story value: Risk reduction
Story value charge: Positive
Mood: Focused, conspiratorial
Outcome: Schedule set: remove feed from demos first, snapshot logs, retain artifacts.

Scene 2:
Characters: Maya, Aaron
Place: Outside the bar, under the bridge
Time: Late night, Day 4
Event: They kiss; agree to 7 a.m. change window.
Conflict: Personal boundaries vs professional stakes.
Story value: Trust/intimacy
Story value charge: Positive
Mood: Vulnerable, tentative
Outcome: Commitment to coordinated removal and secrecy.

Chapter 12:
Scene 1:
Characters: Jonah, Board ops, Leila, Execs
Place: Analytics war room / Looker
Time: Morning, Day 5
Event: Jonah publishes tiles tying conversion lifts to the shadow feed; Leila orders “Zero Click” to ship.
Conflict: Data is celebrated; risk context ignored.
Story value: Visibility vs prudence
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Triumphant yet fraught
Outcome: Exec mandate to ship despite flagged risks.

Scene 2:
Characters: Aaron, Maya
Place: SOC nook
Time: Late night, Day 5
Event: Aaron confronts Maya with a midnight Okta admin edit from her token; she says she rotated a stale secret.
Conflict: Trust fracture—intent vs optics.
Story value: Credibility
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Accusatory, defensive
Outcome: No consensus; Aaron adds her edit to the incident timeline.

Chapter 13:
Scene 1:
Characters: Aaron, Facilities contractor, Rishi
Place: Lobby turnstiles and lab
Time: Afternoon, Day 6
Event: Aaron proves visitor temp badges can clone IDs; demo script replicates door and printer auth.
Conflict: Facilities downplays as “edge case”; Aaron records exploit.
Story value: Security posture
Story value charge: Positive
Mood: Clinical, damning
Outcome: Exploit validated; evidence archived.

Scene 2:
Characters: Aaron, Rishi
Place: Security conference room
Time: Evening, Day 6
Event: They draft token-rotation and log-restoration plan, sequencing Okta, Snowflake, and service accounts.
Conflict: Rotation risks breaking demos; they add rollback and shadow logging.
Story value: Containment
Story value charge: Positive
Mood: Operational, pragmatic
Outcome: Playbook ready pending exec approval.

Chapter 14:
Scene 1:
Characters: Sloane, Legal team, Tom, Felix, Aaron
Place: Legal war room
Time: Morning, Day 7
Event: Sloane circulates near-final misuse draft; Tom reiterates 48-hour BAA ultimatum; Felix threatens Aaron’s partner track.
Conflict: Legal risk vs career survival; wording diluted by exec pressure.
Story value: Leverage
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Adversarial, corner-cutting
Outcome: Draft softened; ultimatum clock still ticking.

Scene 2:
Characters: Aaron, Maya, Data lineage analyst, Jonah (as subject)
Place: Data governance console
Time: Late afternoon, Day 7
Event: Lineage shows Jonah forking Maya’s demo model; triggers 72-hour disclosure clock under internal policy.
Conflict: Maya’s ownership implicated; Aaron insists on disclosure despite fallout.
Story value: Exposure/transparency
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Inevitable, cold
Outcome: Disclosure timer started; stakeholders notified.

chapters: Maya triggers the incident playbook with Ava, freezes ClearLambda in Snowflake, revokes Okta tokens, rotates keys, and legal‑holds raw.calendar. (+)
Victor corners Maya in Hudson Yards and orders her to downplay healthcare exposure or forget the VP and the term sheet. (-)
Aaron restores full Okta exports via API, proves a visitor badge cloned Maya’s ID, and ties the 2 a.m. edit to Jonah’s workstation using Leila’s shared admin token. (+)
Sloane gets a confirmed leak from an internal source and alerts her editor, forcing a 48‑hour disclosure window. (-)
In the boardroom, Maya presents a consent‑first rebuild and vendor exit; Ava backs it, and the board votes to pause and disclose. (+)
Leila resists losing change control, admits the shared token policy, and engineering stalls while Rishi enforces new approvals. (-)
Maya executes the ClearLambda termination with clawback; Tom signs an interim BAA after reviewing the DPIA and PHI segregation plan. (+)
Aaron declines Felix’s “bless‑it” promotion, and Felix pulls him off a flagship diligence to signal consequences. (-)
On the LIC waterfront, Maya and Aaron set no‑secrets rules, he agrees to advise pro bono, and Flatiron ships Sprint “Friction, On Purpose.” (+)
act_scenes:
Chapter 15:
Scene 1:
Characters: Maya, Ava, Aaron
Place: Flatiron Security War Room (Zoom + office)
Time: Early morning, Day 1
Event: Maya triggers incident playbook; Ava authorizes freeze; Aaron preps task list.
Conflict: Speed vs completeness—freeze risks breaking revenue dashboards.
Story value: Control
Story value charge: Positive
Mood: Tense, surgical
Outcome: Go/no‑go agreed; immediate containment initiated.

Scene 2:
Characters: Maya, Ava, Tom (GC), Rishi
Place: Flatiron Ops + Legal Slack, Snowflake console
Time: Mid‑morning, Day 1
Event: Freeze ClearLambda in Snowflake, revoke Okta tokens, rotate keys, place legal hold on raw.calendar.
Conflict: Access friction—teams locked out; Tom insists on broader hold scope.
Story value: Exposure
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Controlled chaos
Outcome: Containment complete; collateral workflow disruption accepted.

Chapter 16:
Scene 1:
Characters: Victor, Maya
Place: Hudson Yards terrace
Time: Afternoon, Day 1
Event: Victor pressures Maya to downplay healthcare exposure to save term sheet and VP title.
Conflict: Ethics vs career advancement.
Story value: Integrity
Story value charge: Positive
Mood: Cold, transactional
Outcome: Maya refuses spin; stakes clarified.

Scene 2:
Characters: Victor, Board liaison (offscreen via text), Maya
Place: Elevator bank, Hudson Yards
Time: Minutes later, Day 1
Event: Victor threatens to slow the deal; implies board support for “minimal disclosure.”
Conflict: Power play vs policy.
Story value: Leverage
Story value charge: Negative
Mood: Coercive
Outcome: Maya leaves with implied retaliation looming.
